director.title: Toward an academic environment that connects students and supervisors on a clear, organized path
messages: It is my pleasure to welcome you to the graduation-projects platform, designed to help our students and professors track projects with full transparency and organization.
We built it as a bridge between students and their supervisors — from topic selection to the final defense — ensuring quality work and a clear path.
We invite all students to make the most of this tool, and we wish them success on their journey to graduation.
director.highlightQuote: A successful graduation project starts with good organization and continuous communication between student and supervisor.

import.guideBody: Sixteen columns in template order — and what goes in each
import.colNote_registrationNumber: Digits only, 6 to 20 — unique in the file and on the platform.
import.colNote_firstName: In Arabic, no digits or symbols.
import.colNote_lastName: In Arabic, no digits or symbols.
import.colNote_firstNameLatin: In Latin letters as on official documents, e.g. Youcef.
import.colNote_lastNameLatin: In Latin letters, e.g. HAMADI — saved in capitals.
import.colNote_gender: Male or female — from the list.
import.colNote_verified: Verified or not verified — empty means not verified.
import.colNote_email: A valid email, unique and not used by another account.
import.colNote_phone: An Algerian number such as 0661234567 — a leading zero dropped by Excel is restored.
import.colNote_password: 8 to 72 characters — left empty, the system generates one.
import.colNote_faculty: From the list — narrows departments and specializations — or leave it to fill from the specialization.
import.colNote_department: From the list (the chosen faculty’s departments only) — or leave it to fill from the specialization.
import.colNote_filiere: From the list (the chosen department’s filières only) — or leave it to fill from the specialization.
import.colNote_level: Licence, master or doctorate — narrows specializations to that level, or fills from it.
import.colNote_specialization: From the list, narrowed by what you chose before it. Anything left empty before it fills from it.
import.accountsHint: Each student with their account and academic record — passwords are only in the accounts file

aboutPage.title: About the platform
aboutPage.subtitle: Mudhakkarati — the digital home of graduation projects at Echahid Hamma Lakhdar University, El Oued.
intro: Mudhakkarati is an integrated digital platform that brings students, supervising professors and the administration together in one place, organising the graduation project from topic proposal to the final defense.
Professors propose topics and follow their teams, students choose what fits their specialisation and apply, and the administration oversees every stage with full transparency.
It was built to cut paperwork, speed up communication, and make sure everyone knows what is expected of them, and when.

features.title: Published, organised topics
features.desc: Topics proposed by professors and approved by the administration, sorted by department and specialisation, each with its status.

features.title: Team requests
features.desc: Students form their teams and apply; the administration follows and decides on each request.

features.title: Supervision follow-up
features.desc: Milestones and deadlines for every project, with direct contact between students and their supervisor.

features.title: Defense scheduling
features.desc: Defenses, juries and rooms scheduled without clashes.

features.title: Messages and notifications
features.desc: Internal messages and instant alerts for everything that concerns you.

features.title: Verifiable documents
features.desc: Supervision documents carry a code that can be scanned to confirm they are genuine.
